mechanism_narrative: A increase in GDP signals a strong economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative when the federal funds rate is below 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative when the unemployment rate is below 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in the unemployment rate signal a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of increasing housing starts and low unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals an increase in economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative when industrial production is above 120.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in the money supply signal an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of decreasing federal funds rate and increasing money supply.

mechanism_narrative: A high employment rate and a low unemployment rate signal a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative during periods of high employment and low unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index signals a decrease in inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative when the consumer price index is below 190.
